definitions.queue_total: every row in the committed acquisition queue
definitions.brand_excluded: rows whose brand is excluded on cost (HYATT, BEST_WESTERN)
definitions.routable_total: queue_total minus brand_excluded; the denominator for every figure below
definitions.touched: an acquisition attempt was made and journalled, whatever its outcome
definitions.publication_grade: the attempt produced evidence satisfying PUBLICATION_GRADE_REQUIRED
definitions.observed: a current-state observation row exists in milwaukee-wi_policy_proposals_001.json

observed_note: the store projects milwaukee-router-001 only; the 17 Marriott (020) and 11 Hilton (023) acquisitions have no row in it. Phase 16 forbids widening the builder input here; that is the dedicated integration work order
note: 'completed' is not used. Touched, publication-grade, observed and published are four different predicates and four different numbers.
